title: Yang-Zhang Outperforms Close-to-Close HV
notes: Pure math test on daily OHLCV. Compares Yang-Zhang HV vs close-to-close HV estimator accuracy against 20-day forward realized vol. No options data needed. No DTE scope applies. Verdict: SUPPORTED if YZ RMSE < CC RMSE by more than 1% (ratio < 0.99), REJECTED if ratio > 1.01, INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
